title: Infinitesimal restrictions give an etale neighborhood of the closed fiber
statement: Let A be a commutative ring complete for an ideal I [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], f : Y → Spec A [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and g : X → Y a finite type morphism [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] with Y locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]. For each n ≥ 0 let Y_n = Y ×_A Spec(A/I^(n+1)) [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-fibre-product]. If X ×_Y Y_n → Y_n is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] for all n, there is an open subset W of X containing g⁻¹(image(Y_0 → Y)), such that W → Y is etale.

source.place: Fundamental Groups, Tag 0GS2, essential-surjectivity proof, using More on Morphisms, Tag 0A43(2)

proof.text: The quotient A → A/I is surjective. Base change its closed immersion of spectra to obtain j : Y_0 → Y and set J = ker(j). On affine Spec R in Y its ideal is IR. Extension of ideals commutes with products, giving J^(n+1) = I^(n+1)R on that affine. The quotient algebras identify the corresponding closed subscheme with Y_n; the canonical quotient identifications commute with restriction and hence glue.

Transport the etale hypotheses along these isomorphisms and apply etale_on_open_of_etale_infinitesimal_neighbourhoods with g, j, J and hJ = rfl. The required locally Noetherian and finite type assumptions are precisely the stated ones.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_open_of_infinitesimal_restrictions
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)) (g : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (h_etale : ∀ n : ℕ, Etale (pullback.snd g (pullback.fst f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))))) :
    ∃ W : X.Opens,
      (g : X → Y) ⁻¹' Set.range
        (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) : _ → _) ⊆
          (W : Set X) ∧ Etale (W.ι ≫ g)
